Package me.manossef.api.alexandria.config

Class OptionValidations

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.manossef.api.alexandria.config.OptionValidations
  • public final class OptionValidations
extends java.lang.Object
    Contains methods for checking whether an option in a configuration file is present or has a value of the correct type. Methods starting with check are intended to be called on startup, while methods starting with recheck are intended to be called on reloads.
